title: Get — senses & collocations (B1)
note: get is the highest-frequency verb Czech students avoid, because Czech splits its senses across different verbs. Own unit because it is too big for trunk_chunks_b1. Sorted by sense: receive, become, arrive, plus the fixed pairs. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. FIVE of the eight shipped frames could never gap — they used the past or 3sg form (*got a letter*, *got married*, *got a new job*, *got ill*, *gets dark*) while the lemma is the base chunk, so sentenceToFrame found nothing. Every frame here holds its chunk verbatim, which on this pack means the base form of get in every one. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. F7: *get lost* belongs to leaf_travel_b1 (path 6) and *get on with* to leaf_relationships_b1 (24); replaced with **get wet** and **get over**. · The frames page offered noun frames (I have a … / I need a …) on a pack of verb chunks; they are get-shapes now. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_get_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: one rewrite item re-cut so replacing the underline reconstructs the answer. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 23 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py — a `get + X` collocation is short by nature, so almost two thirds of this bank was one clause long. All 23 rewritten to make one clause move and carry two or more already-taught words; every multi-word `get` lemma stays contiguous, so sentenceToFrame still gaps the whole collocation and not just the verb. 0/36 fail now.

intro.title: get = arrive, move, and fixed pairs
intro.title_cz: get = dorazit, pohyb a ustálené dvojice

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: Czech uses a different verb for each of these — *dostat*, *stát se*, *dojít*. English uses **get** for all three, and the sense comes from the word after it.
intro.note_cz: Čeština má pro každý význam jiné sloveso. Angličtina má **get** a význam určuje slovo za ním.

sentences.en: Children get a present from their grandparents when the family meets at Christmas.
sentences.cz: Děti dostanou od prarodičů dárek, když se rodina sejde o Vánocích.
accepts: Children get a present from their grandparents when the family meets at Christmas

sentences.en: I get a letter from the bank every month although the account is online.
sentences.cz: Každý měsíc dostanu dopis z banky, i když je účet online.
accepts: I get a letter from the bank every month although the account is online

sentences.en: It is hard to get a job in a small town, but the rent is lower.
sentences.cz: V malém městě je těžké sehnat práci, ale nájem je nižší.
accepts: It is hard to get a job in a small town, but the rent is lower

sentences.en: You can get a ticket at the machine by the door, but it does not take cards.
sentences.cz: Lístek si můžeš koupit v automatu u dveří, ale nebere karty.

sentences.en: We get paid on the last Friday of the month.
sentences.cz: Výplatu dostáváme poslední pátek v měsíci.

sentences.en: I get a call from my mother every Sunday, although we live in the same street.
sentences.cz: Každou neděli mi volá máma, i když bydlíme ve stejné ulici.

sentences.en: Can you get some bread on your way home because the shop closes at six?

accepts: Can you get some bread on your way home because the shop closes at six?

sentences.en: Sometimes I get an idea in the night, but I forget it by the morning.

sentences.en: You will get an email when the booking is ready, but check the spam folder.

accepts: You will get an email when the booking is ready, but check the spam folder

sentences.en: She wants to get a degree before she is thirty, although she works full-time.
sentences.cz: Chce získat titul, než jí bude třicet, i když pracuje na plný úvazek.

sentences.en: We get the keys after we pay the deposit.

sentences.en: I get the shopping on Saturday morning because the shops are empty then.

sentences.en: I get tired if I read after ten, although I sleep for eight hours.

sentences.en: Children get ill more often in the winter when the weather changes quickly.

sentences.en: He does not get angry, but he stops talking.

He doesn't get angry, but he stops talking

sentences.en: They want to get married in the spring.

sentences.en: I get worried when the phone rings at night.

sentences.en: In December it can get dark before the children leave school.

sentences.en: You will get wet if you walk home in this rain.

sentences.en: Everybody wants to get old, but nobody wants to look old.

sentences.en: It takes me ten minutes to get ready in the morning because I choose my clothes at night.

sentences.en: How do you get to work when the trains are not running?

sentences.en: We want to get away for a few days in October when the hotels are cheaper.

sentences.en: We should get going because the train leaves in ten minutes.
